notes.title: Easter Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038725/62e3eaf2c00e9d0e632ebce5c34ec439cb395ab9.png
We are bringing you all the Easter Update.


Changes

 Floor is Lava, The Grey and Horror Notes are disabled by default now.
 Fixed a bug that would reset familiars
 Unlockables now show what you needed to do to unlock them, after you've unlocked them.
 Replaced word library for Keyboard Warriors
 Changed DirectX to 11, this should fix the rare crashes some players were getting.
 Increased Legion's movement hitbox to 10 centimeters, up from 1.
 Fixed Mimic not getting top hat during Formal Attire
 Added 9 Easter Egg body colors
 Added Bunny Mode Chaos Infusion
 Added Bunny Ears unlockable


If you're unable to find players, you can always join our Discord to find others looking for a match.

notes.title: 🌟 LIGHT BEARERS 2 - OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT 🌟
notes.content:
🌙 TWO WAYS TO PLAY 🌙
Legacy Mode
For returning players
 Original Light Bearers 1 pacing
 Legacy wall jump physics preserved
 Modernized game feel
 No sprinting/sliding - pure strategy
 Perfect for veterans craving nostalgia
 Restricted Shadow movement


Chaos Mode
For adrenaline seekers
 Infinite sprint & slide-chaining momentum
 Enhanced wall-jump precision (launch off most surface!)
 Shadows/Bears gain aerial control
 Frantic 360° engagements



🔧 CORE SYSTEMS 🔧
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038725/2abe2c80e36c010582fe71dbb66aefb56b946f30.gif
Chaos Infusion Engine
 6,647 unique infusion combinations
 Light Infusions: Light Bear boosts (e.g., Heimdall saves random bears)
 Map Infusions: Flow changers (e.g., Hold the flag, hot potatoes that explode)
 Shadow Infusions: Shadow team enhancements (e.g.: immortal snails that hunt bears)
 Shadows get one reroll


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038725/cbab8af038ac0ed3939d025942d80c1783f1673e.gif
Revamped Movement
 Edge Forgiveness: small time window to jump after running off an edge
 Momentum Slides: Chain slides into speed boosts
 Smart Wall Detection: reliable jump off of most surfaces
 Forgiving Hit Detection: Eliminates "I was touching them!" frustration


🎮 KEY IMPROVEMENTS 🎮

 Pulse Vision: Shadows detect uncrouched Bears through walls every few seconds
 Light Fading: Crouch to dim your glow and vanish into darkness
 Tri-Camera Checks: While crouched your neck/torso/hips must ALL be visible to be seen
 Sum of its parts: tons of improvements that add to the overall upgraded experience

Content Expansion

 29 Maps: 17 remastered classics + 12 new eerie playgrounds
 18 Remastered Shadows 
 7 New Shadows (DLC): Unlocked for all if any player owns the pack
 Powerful familiars that grant passives
 Bear bodies that change your abilities


🖥️ TECHNICAL UPGRADES🖥️


Visual Customization

 4 Anti-Aliasing Options: TSR, TAA, FXAA, Off
 Dynamic FOV Slider (60°-120°) affects both Bear/Shadow perspectives
 Custom Outline Colors: Recolor ally/enemy/neutral silhouettes


Accessibility Suite

 Visual Footstep Radar (hearing-impaired support)
 Adjust Team Outline Colors
 Cooldown Displays: Choose icons/numbers/both/neither
 One-Click Mute/Censor Tools


👥 COMMUNITY FEATURES 👥

 Peer-to-Peer Hosting: Private and public lobbies with friends
 Shared DLC Shadows: One owner unlocks for entire lobby
 Remastered Net Code: Smoother latency
 "The game exists even if we don’t"



⚖️ LIGHT FAVORED & SHADOW FAVORED ⚖️
Customize the balance of power

Shadow Favored
Standard gameplay rules

Light Favored

 Protection Bubble: Prevents Shadows from camping tagged Bears
 Slower Transformation: Bears take longer to turn into Shadows
 Extended Vision Cooldown: Shadow Pulse Vision is 3x slower
 Pool of Light Reset: Escaping fully resets the timer
 Reduced Shadow Vision: Smaller player-spotting cone for Shadow Bears
 Portal Nerf: Shadow Portal teleport cooldown is doubled


💎Fair Monetization 💎

 Free to play
 One DLC, One time.
 DLC owners share premium shadows with their lobbies
 Unlocks DLC content immediately, no need to grind
 New Bodies
 New Familiars
 New Cosmetics
 New Host Settings
 Helps find your money a loving home

notes.title: Playtest Concluded
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, thanks for taking part in the Playtest!

We have closed the test. We want to thank everyone for participating in it. Please if you have not, fill out the survey → Survey 1 Link. It helps us make sure that our current course is correct. I'd also like to clarify a couple of things.

Each Shadow from LB1 has been reworked/adjusted and is already in LB2. This test had limited content, in order to focus what we wanted players to experience.

The Chaos modifier system has been well received by the majority of players. However we did get a few requests for the host to choose which ones are active, that functionality is already in the game and was present during the test.

There were a few complaints about the balance of a subset of the Shadows. We’ll review those and make a determination of what, if any, action needs to be taken for them.

Overall, it looks like you all enjoyed the game. Which was awesome to read and has given us further fervor towards the last stretch of development. If you’ve already filled out the first survey, we forgot to ask a few questions, if you could fill this one out as well. That would be amazing!

Second Survey → Survey 2 Link

Make sure to wishlist and follow for future news!

notes.title: August Weekend Test
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

We wanted to announce that we will be holding a weekend test on the 23rd-25th. This test will be a vertical slice, containing a small chunk of the game. 

Make sure if you want to take part in this, that you opt into the playtest now. You should also have any friends, family, co-workers, cool neighbors also opt in.  If you have none of those, feel free to jump into our Discord to find others to play with that weekend.

If this goes well, we will try and do 1 or 2 more weekends before we launch next March. Each time with different sections of content.

Thank you for reading!
